setup: Use existing Node, TypeScript, ESLint, fast-check, c8 and Playwright tooling. No dependencies, migrations or commits. Preserve unrelated workspace changes. Run through the existing bounded disposable Compose wrapper with teardown registered before startup.
behaviors: Dispatch sees a free-text override next to pre-approval. Change normalizes 530pm, 5:30 PM, 17:30 and until 05:30 pm to until 05:30 pm. Blank keeps the configured default for a new approval; malformed input cannot submit.

Override uses the next occurrence of the entered Toronto wall-clock time, today or tomorrow. Server determines the date. Handle winter/summer offsets and repeated fall-back times; reject nonexistent spring-forward times.

Confirm/propose may override only that request. Accept retains the deadline. Active proposed/preapproved requests allow Dispatch to save a new deadline without changing their window, quote or status. Reminder is relative to the new deadline and never before the save time.

Dispatch sees a red Expire request button for submitted/proposed/preapproved requests. A warning names the request and explains Sales must re-raise. Cancel/Escape makes no request; confirm expires it immediately.

Sales, public users and wrong-yard actors cannot change expiry. Secured, expired and cancelled requests reject manual expiry and deadline changes. Requests past their automatic deadline cannot be revived.

Revision checks, transaction locks and idempotency prevent conflicting deadline, secure and expiry actions. Exactly one competing action commits. Manual expiry records the Dispatch actor and alerts Sales; later scheduler ticks cannot repeat expiry.

Default three-hour expiry, global settings, other requests, existing request workflows, SO/TO links and delivery instruction behavior survive unchanged. New tests include generated parsing round-trips, hostile input, HTTP/database races and browser confirmation behavior.
amendments: Repository discovery: Dispatch has access across all delivery yards. Preserve that existing policy; wrong-yard restrictions apply to Sales. No new Dispatch yard restriction is introduced.

failureModel.wrong_deadline_or_timezone: Fixed-clock winter, summer, midnight and DST tests; generated parsing round-trips.
failureModel.unintended_global_or_other_request_chang: Database assertions compare settings and a second request.
failureModel.unauthorized_or_stale_mutation: Role, yard, revision and hostile-input tests over the real router/service.
failureModel.secure_expire_update_races: Concurrent database actions must have one winner and consistent links/events.
failureModel.accidental_expiry: Browser warning cancel, Escape and confirmation tests, red button computed style.
failureModel.resource_or_cleanup_failure: Existing shared test slice and Compose limits; teardown verifies containers, volumes, networks and production health.
